facts.fact: 深夜，风掀开她阁楼的钢制舱门——她被惊得转身，以为深夜无人来访。
facts.anchor: A gust of wind blew the heavy steel hatch of my loft open.

facts.fact: 一个骑在隆隆黑烟云上的身影落在阳台：厚重兜帽斗篷翻飞、浅金色头发；他一落地，整片荒漠似乎安静下来。
facts.anchor: With a flutter of his thick, hooded cloak and pale, blond hair against the darkened skies, a shadowy figure rode the ominous, rumbling clouds rolling in. Still in a fog-like cover of black smoke, he touched down on the balcony. The entire desert seemed to hush.

facts.fact: 他那双钢蓝色的眼睛与她相遇时，她捂住胸口——换过心的身体反应。
facts.anchor: Starting to heave, I clutched at my chest as those steel-blue eyes met mine.

facts.fact: 他跨过两人之间的距离，长而从容；那不像移动，更像必然；只有饥渴、只有笃定。
facts.anchor: He crossed the gap between us in long, deliberate strides that felt less like movement and more like inevitability. There was no hesitation in him—only hunger, only certainty.

facts.fact: 他持续逼近，她一步步退让，呼吸变乱，世界缩到两人之间的空隙。
facts.anchor: When he reached me, the heat of his body collided with mine, and he did not stop. He kept coming, pressing forward until I yielded step by step, my breath faltering as the world narrowed to the space between us.

facts.fact: 天亮醒来，她确认整场是梦。
她决定：无论他变成了什么、我们曾经是什么，她都要走出那扇门面对它。
facts.anchor: There was only one conclusion left to accept. Whatever he had become, whatever we had been, I would walk through that door and face it.

facts.fact: 她套上实验服、拿起自己唯一的那只靴子，踏上门外的金属阳台。
facts.anchor: I threw up my hands in resignation. “Fine. Fine. I suppose it is high time to pay tribute to His Royal Majesty.” I unhooked my lab coat from the wall and threw it on, then grabbed my one boot. As I stepped through the hatch onto the metal balcony, that voice boomed again.

facts.fact: 男仆手中凭空出现铁镣铐；她的回应是“You have got to be kidding me.”
facts.anchor: I stared at the iron shackles magically appearing in the blank-faced footman’s grip. My jaw dropped in full skepticism. “You have got to be kidding me.”
